Tamil Nadu CM Seeks New Operator for Chennai Airport

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi requesting a change in the operator for Chennai Airport. The Chief Minister cited concerns regarding the airport's performance in passenger, aircraft movement, and cargo handling. This move follows the state's decision to drop plans for a new airport in Parandur. Sources indicated the government is seeking a new operator for the existing Chennai airport.
